title: Queued-row 'Take over manually' is a dead control: the r2 W6 menu entry opens a RefcheckConfirmTakeOver that the Queued row body never renders
location: client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:594-605 (Queued arm of row_detail) vs 489-494 (overflow_actions) and 627-631/663-667 (confirm render sites)
evidence: Queued arm: 'Queued -> html.div([class("space-y-3")], [ html.p(...refcheck_state_queued...), case pending_confirm(call.reference_call_id, RefcheckConfirmStart, confirm) { True -> view_start_confirm(call, app, slot, inflight) False -> element.none() } ])' — only RefcheckConfirmStart is checked. Menu: 'Queued -> list.append([RefcheckStart, RefcheckSkip], case call.hooks.can_take_over { True -> [RefcheckTakeOver] False -> [] })'. view_take_over_confirm call sites: lines 627-631 (Unreachable) and 663-667 (ContactInitiated) only.
detail: W6 added the queued menu entry (can_take_over is True for queued), and UserChoseRefcheckAction(RefcheckTakeOver) sets the confirm — but the Queued body renders only the start confirm, so the take-over confirm is swallowed. Clicking does nothing.
recommended_fix: Render view_take_over_confirm in the Queued arm when pending_confirm(call_id, RefcheckConfirmTakeOver, confirm), and pin with a queued-row confirm render test (the existing take-over confirm test uses ContactInitiated).

title: STILL PRESENT (r2): the client's ?slot= per-row start wire format has no test
evidence: start_check: 'let url = base_url(vacancy_id, application_id) <> "/start"' then 'let url = case slot { Some(s) -> url <> "?slot=" <> s None -> url }' — and `grep -rn "slot=" client/test/` returns nothing; no client test asserts the URL (server-side 400 + per-slot creation are pinned in server/test/integration/reference_checks_actions_integration_test.gleam:812,1140).
detail: The per-row start wire contract (the RC2.3 pre-declared ?slot= variant) is still pinned only server-side; the client URL construction can drift uncaught.
recommended_fix: Add a client unit test asserting start_check builds '/start?slot=<s>' for Some(slot) and '/start' for None (mirror vacancy_api_test's decoder-pin pattern).
